propositions: The overlap judge re-sends the query ticket's digest in full on every call despite it being identical across a batch, wasting input tokens in the volatile user block where caching cannot reach
The query digest can be hoisted into the system prompt to sit behind the cache breakpoint, making it writable once and readable on remaining calls within the batch
The real minimum cacheable prefix for claude-sonnet-4-6 is 1024 tokens, not the 4096 documented for Opus, but the hoisted prefix (846 tokens measured) falls short and produces zero cache reads

Moving the query digest to the system prompt preserves judgment precision (12 of 12 ordered pairs maintain identical relations) but increases total input tokens by 936 (+5.8%) due to the added orientation paragraph
